$help: Every link a product's sales kit uses, in one place. Edit a value, save, and git-autosync pushes it within a minute.
onePager, salesDeck, featureList: the kit documents. Paste a link anyone at Oracle or SoftServe can open. The kit email picks it up at once; nothing else to run.
interactiveDemo, interactiveDemoArtifact, video: these also drive the site's buttons. After changing one, run  node tools/sync-links.js  and publish the site.

interactiveDemo is the walkthrough's path inside site/ (or a full https:// URL). interactiveDemoArtifact is the same walkthrough published as its own claude.ai artifact, used while the site itself runs as one. video is the recorded demo: a YouTube, Vimeo, SharePoint or Stream link.
Leave a value as "" while the artifact does not exist: the kit email leaves it out, and the practice's copy of the request names it as missing.
siteUrl is the address the kit email links product pages to. This file is never published: it sits outside site/.
